display.title: Episode 36: Three Lost on an Island, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: Practicing the great march out of golus, and the first chapter of a parable: a doctor, a scientist and an engineer shipwrecked on a deserted island.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi recalls the great marches of Jewish history: leaving Egypt through the sea, crossing the Jordan with Yehoshua, and going up to the Beis HaMikdash three times a year. One more grand parade is coming soon, when Moshiach leads everyone out of golus, so Tzivos Hashem's soldiers practice with a lively march. Story time begins an unusual story with a lesson for life: three survivors of a shipwreck reach a deserted island. A returning guest in Studio 604 talks about fighting the yetzer hara with Torah and mitzvos before leading the Shema. Back on the island, the doctor finds a rare apple that cures any illness, the scientist builds a telescope, and the engineer repairs an abandoned airplane. As they prepare to leave, the scientist sees something astonishing through his telescope, to be continued next week. In the mailbox, a boy sends a joke about a bar mitzvah boy and four drawings of mitzvos, and the show closes with an invitation to buy a letter in the new children's Sefer Torah, which unites all Jews.
display.lesson: Practice now for the great march with Moshiach by fighting the yetzer hara with Torah and mitzvos.
